name: app-three-onboarding-screens-in-slate-blue-with-financial-hub-and-bill-pay
title: Three light-to-slate-blue onboarding screens: banking simplified, growth hub and bill pay, with an italic serif headline
whatItIs: An off-white board with a pill label, a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif 'Banking Experience.' and three phones on a stepped layout: a transfer card with amount, a growth hub with a weekly bar and stats, and a bill-pay arc of icons with a receipt, each with a progress line and Skip and Next buttons.
whatItMeans: Calm and reassuring; white cards over a slate gradient guide the user step by step.
techniques: Fade screens from white to slate at the bottom.
Use two bottom buttons: Skip and a navy Next.
Show a preview card in each step.

vocabulary.definition: Onboarding screens each showing a benefit.
A secondary and a primary button together.
A small card showing the feature.
